items.title: How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts
items.snippet: How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts Parameter Labs describe an exploit they found against ChatGPT's implementation of the artifacts pattern (OpenAI used to call this "Canvas" but it looks like the latest revision is called HTML previews ), where interactive custom HTML apps are displayed in a sandboxed iframe. It's important that HTML in these stays tightly sandboxed to avoid untrusted code interacting with OpenAI APIs and accessing private data. Parameter found quite a complex attack chain. OpenA
items.title_ar: ثغرة تسمح بالاستيلاء على حسابات ChatGPT عبر عرض HTML
items.summary_ar: كشفت Parameter Labs ثغرة استغلال ضد آلية عرض التطبيقات التفاعلية في ChatGPT، وهي تعمل داخل iframe معزول. الهدف من هذا العزل منع الكود غير الموثوق من التفاعل مع واجهات OpenAI والوصول إلى بيانات خاصة. وصفت الجهة سلسلة هجوم معقدة، لكن النص المتاح مقطوع فلا تتوفر تفاصيل أكثر.
items.why_ar: مهم لأي POC يعرض كوداً مولداً بالذكاء الاصطناعي، لأنه يوضح مخاطر العزل الضعيف لمراجعة الأمان.

items.title: From synthetic enterprise data evaluations to real Microsoft Copilot AI confidence
items.snippet: Evaluating Microsoft Copilot at enterprise scale requires test data that captures the full complexity of real organizations, yet real enterprise data contains sensitive information that cannot be used for evaluation under any circumstances. The post From synthetic enterprise data evaluations to real Microsoft Copilot AI confidence appeared first on Microsoft Research .
items.title_ar: تقييم Copilot ببيانات مؤسسية اصطناعية بدلاً من البيانات الحقيقية

items.title: Unlocking Any-Order Generation in Pretrained Autoregressive Image Models
items.snippet: Autoregressive (AR) image generators are powerful in principle but inflexible in practice: training with a fixed raster-scan order hardcodes a single factorization of the image distribution into the model, leaving it unable to inpaint, outpaint, or edit at inference time. Existing solutions, including the modern discrete-diffusion family, train from scratch on a mixture of token orderings, paying roughly 3x the compute of standard raster-scan training; discrete diffusion further sacrifices compatibility with the AR inference ecosystem (KV caching, vLLM) by construction. items.title_ar: توليد الصور بأي ترتيب في نماذج Autoregressive المدربة مسبقاً
items.summary_ar: تعالج الورقة قيد نماذج توليد الصور الانحدارية التي تُدرّب على ترتيب ثابت من أعلى لأسفل، مما يمنعها من الرسم الداخلي أو التوسيع أو التحرير وقت الاستدلال. الحلول الحالية تتطلب تدريباً من الصفر بتكلفة تقارب ثلاثة أضعاف. يرى الباحثون أن النموذج المدرب مسبقاً قد تعلّم التوزيع المشترك بالفعل، مما يجعل التكلفة الإضافية غير ضرورية حسب طرحهم.

items.title: Training Foundation Models with a Single Algorithm
items.snippet: Foundation models are typically trained in stages: pretraining, midtraining, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL), with changes in both data and learning algorithms. We show that this algorithmic separation is not fundamental. By deriving suitable RL objectives as maximum-likelihood fitting to model-generated target distributions, we place all of these stages under a single likelihood-based training algorithm, unified training. This perspective turns the foundation-model training lifecycle into a problem of choosing which data to train on, in what proportions, and when, with conventional staged training as a special case. items.title_ar: تدريب النماذج الأساسية بخوارزمية واحدة بدلاً من مراحل منفصلة

items.why_ar: فهم هذا الإطار يساعد في تصميم خطوط تدريب أو ضبط نماذج داخلية بطريقة أبسط وأقل تعقيداً.

items.title: Proving and Improving the Platonic Representation Hypothesis with JEPAs
items.snippet: Whether models trained on different modalities converge to the same representation of the world is central to AI. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) conjectures that they do as they scale, but without a proof it offers neither a guarantee nor a recipe. We turn the hypothesis into a theorem. First, we prove a Platonic Representation Theorem: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) trained separately on any number of modalities learn the same representation up to one rotation whenever their positive pairs are two observations of one scene--good views--and their misalignment is bounded otherwise. items.title_ar: إثبات فرضية التمثيل الأفلاطوني باستخدام نماذج JEPA

items.title: EPSBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Earnings Forecasting
items.snippet: Quarterly earnings forecasting requires an agent to connect financial evidence to the income-statement line items that produce a company's reported earnings. We introduce EPSBench, a benchmark for studying this ability across 149 firm-quarters from 86 US companies. Agents read a fixed collection of filings, earnings-call transcripts, and news, then estimate company-specific income-statement drivers with cited evidence. A shared accounting calculator converts these estimates into GAAP diluted earnings per share (EPS), providing a common basis for comparing forecast assumptions. items.title_ar: EPSBench: معيار لقياس وكلاء LLM في توقع أرباح السهم
items.summary_ar: يقدم EPSBench معياراً لتقييم قدرة وكلاء النماذج اللغوية على ربط الأدلة المالية ببنود قائمة الدخل التي تنتج ربحية الشركة. يشمل 149 ربعاً مالياً لـ86 شركة أمريكية. يقارن الوكلاء بتوقعات المحللين ويحسب ربحية السهم وفق GAAP بأداة محاسبية مشتركة. تُقيَّم ستة نماذج تحت إطار موحد.

items.title: Weaken to Strengthen: Weakening-Induced On-Policy Self-Distillation for Large Reasoning Models
items.snippet: Self-distillation offers a way to improve reasoning models when a suitable external teacher is unavailable. However, common approaches rely on privileged information to construct a stronger self-teacher, limiting their use when only unlabeled prompts are available. In this paper, we introduce Weakening-Induced On-Policy Self-Distillation (WISD), which instead constructs a weaker counterpart of the original model and uses the contrast between the two as a training signal without requiring privileged information. items.title_ar: WISD: تحسين نماذج الاستدلال بالتقطير الذاتي عبر إضعاف النموذج

items.title: datasette-llm 0.1a9
items.snippet: Release: datasette-llm 0.1a9 I have some big upgrades to Datasette Agent in the pipeline, but in the meantime here's a tiny user experience improvement to the underlying datasette-llm plugin. It now picks up the default model used by LLM , which means you can start using Datasette Agent without needing to explicitly configure a default model: uvx --with datasette-agent datasette content.db --internal internal.db Previously you would also need to specify a model with -s plugins.datasette-agent.de

items.title: FDSML: Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning with Parameter-Aware Triplet Loss
items.snippet: Formula-Driven Supervised Learning (FDSL) enables vision pre-training without real images, but existing methods cast pre-training as classification on discretized labels, discarding continuity in the generative process. We propose Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning (FDSML), which derives relational supervision from image-generation parameters beyond discrete class labels. FDSML combines FineFractalDB, our refined fractal dataset with higher intra-class variation and more stable structures, with a Parameter-Aware Triplet (PA-Triplet) Loss that assigns positives and negatives according to distances in the underlying Iterated Function System parameter space. items.summary_ar: تقدم الورقة FDSML، وهي طريقة تدريب مسبق للرؤية الحاسوبية بدون صور حقيقية، تعتمد على صيغ رياضية. تستخدم مجموعة بيانات FineFractalDB مع خسارة Triplet تعتمد على مسافات في فضاء معاملات نظام الدوال المتكررة. النتيجة تعلم تمثيلات أكثر استمرارية من التصنيف المتقطع.
